en-us.neon_karaoke_hiring: "We hire part-time receptionists and room attendants. Day shift is 12-22 at 1,200 yen an hour; late shift is 22-05 at 1,500. Paid daily."
en-us.neon_live_hiring: "Tickets and bar work runs 15-24 at 1,300 yen an hour, paid daily. We are not recruiting band members."
en-us.neon_massage_hiring: "We are only registering practitioners for standby. No customers or extra menu. The 12-22 shift pays 1,500 yen an hour; 22-02 pays 1,875, settled daily."
en-us.neon_izakaya_hiring: "Evening shift is 17-22 at 1,200 yen an hour. The 22-01 shift pays 1,500. Paid daily."
en-us.neon_bartender_hiring: "Bartenders earn 1,400 yen an hour on the 19-24 shift, or 1,750 on the 22-04 shift. Paid daily."
en-us.neon_adult_hiring: "These are voluntarily chosen standby posts, and workers may quit. There are currently no customers, hostess services or dispatches, and no per-client pay. Standby pays 1,800 yen an hour, or 2,250 on shifts starting at 22, settled daily."
en-us.neon_adult_apply_question: "Select a candidate only if this is their voluntary application for standby. Otherwise, cancel."
en-us.neon_apply_done:
"Registered. The shift can be changed later."
(Change shifts in the permanent household's Management Jobs tab.)
en-us.neon_adult_apply_done:
"Registered for standby, not consent to any service. You may change shifts or quit here."
(Change shifts in the permanent household's Management Jobs tab.)
en-us.neon_quit_done: "The resignation is processed. Thank you for your work."
en-us.neon_staff_cancel_line: "Then we will leave things as they are."
